drhp.business: The Company manufactures Writing & Printing paper, tissue products, and caustic soda/chlor-alkali chemicals. It serves domestic institutional, corporate, and retail customers across education, FMCG, pharmaceuticals, e-commerce, hospitality, and healthcare, with exports to UAE and other markets. Operations are supported by in-house agro-forestry for wood pulp and a chemical plant that supplies internal and external demand.
drhp.expansion: The Company has initiated a capex project for installing a new Tissue line. This capital infusion shall bring in state-of-art technology to Orient Paper and help it stay relevant in today's markets by expanding its product basket and improving its profitability. This shall de-commoditize the Company's product mix and shift it towards value-added categories. The Company continued to invest towards the upkeep of its assets with a capex of ~ Rs 52 crores in FY26.

risks.note: Transit permit restrictions on wood movement in Madhya Pradesh led to ~7% higher sourcing cost and impacted fibre yield; though partially reversed, such policy changes create recurring cost and quality risks.
risks.risk: Raw material sourcing cost inflation and supply disruption due to regulatory restrictions

risks.note: Writing & Printing paper prices dropped ~4% due to nil-duty imports and sluggish tenders; tissue prices fell ~7.5% as the market absorbed new capacity, squeezing margins despite record volumes.
risks.risk: Pricing pressure from imports and domestic overcapacity

risks.note: Operational gains and small-scale high-impact projects were insufficient to counter pricing declines and government-driven sourcing cost increases, leading to squeezed operating margins.
risks.risk: Margin compression from inability to offset external headwinds

risks.note: Government policies inflating sourcing-side costs (e.g., transit permit rules) directly impact profitability, and GST reforms affecting the notebook segment add demand-side uncertainty.
risks.risk: Regulatory and policy risk affecting cost structure

risks.note: The new tissue line capex project aims to de-commoditize the product mix, but delays, cost overruns, or failure to achieve value-added penetration could impair expected profitability improvement.
risks.risk: Technology and capex execution risk in shifting product mix

risks.note: The Caustic Soda business missed its GHG target set by MoEFCC, creating potential regulatory exposure or cost if carbon market mechanisms impose penalties or require credit purchases.
risks.risk: Environmental compliance risk in Caustic Soda business
